sections.title: Themes in Music Hist: Being a Gentleman Amateur
sections.description: In this course, students will have the opportunity to explore music history from a thematic or conceptual perspective, frequently through several eras. Among the topics that we will explore: opera and its literary and figurative sources 1600-1900; opera performance 1600-today; music and rhetoric ca. 1500-1800; text, music, image ca. 1500-1650.
